orders.instruction: Fix 89.8% no-ops: probe each available key and clicks on distinct visible components, comparing frames before and after. Learn which actions change state; suppress repeated ineffective state-action pairs and prioritize unexplored transitions toward level completion.

Fix narrow exploration (13 distinct states): segment visible clickable components and probe each, including previously ignored components. Learn click effects from frame changes; avoid repeated state-click pairs and test ordered click sequences that produce new states or completion.

First attempt: probe available keys and clicks on visible components separately, recording resulting state changes. Learn action effects online, then pursue reproducible progress sequences. Add visited-state/action avoidance and stop repeating actions that leave the frame unchanged.

summary: Fill all three slots: repair the strongest no-op and narrow-exploration failures, plus explore an untouched eight-level game. Target completed levels above every control; stop scheduling at 85% budget usage.
